# The Cutting-Edge On-Call Landscape

Here's the thing about the on-call landscape: it is genuinely a game-changer once teams leverage the right signal.
The truth is that most rotations were never designed to navigate this alert volume.

An on-call rotation produces a continuous record of where a system fails. Alert volume concentrated on a handful of
components says those components carry responsibilities their design never anticipated. Any alert firing twice in a
month should get a short scheduled review with a written outcome: remediate, decommission, or accept and disable
deliberately.

At the end of the day, the bottom line is straightforward. Move the review out of the overnight window and the
same decision gets made with better information.
